purpose: Reusable Miguel Design OS patterns for authored scroll routes, pinned stages, media transformations, card assembly, portal entry, chapter navigation, and reduced-motion storyboards.

patterns.name: Scroll Route Choreography
patterns.whatItDoes: The page route moves horizontally, then vertically, then horizontally again. Content behaves like territories on a physical board.
whenToUse: award-level landing, portfolio, editorial, brand, playful product, or video-first page
scroll needs to change spatial context or information depth
references ask for authored travel rather than section stacking
whenNotToUse: dense productivity tool
settings or form-heavy workflow
accessibility-critical path where ceremony blocks task completion
mobile-only utility flow where speed matters more than choreography
patterns.implementationApproach: Choose the lightest honest stack: CSS scroll-driven animations, React scroll progress, Motion useScroll/useTransform, or GSAP ScrollTrigger for pin/scrub/horizontal choreography when required.
patterns.accessibilityFallback: Content remains in DOM order, keyboard reachable, readable without scroll effects, and not hidden behind pointer-only gestures.
patterns.reducedMotionFallback: Replace travel with static ordered chapters, instant state changes, or gentle opacity swaps that preserve the story sequence.
scoreCaps: fake or invisible selected pattern: max 4
